opportunities.title: Small Grants

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000; travel support up to £2,000-£2,500 per person, PhD fieldwork up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. No applications from individuals for personal projects. PhD students supported for travel/fieldwork. Projects must involve UK-Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects in arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Supports events, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/exchanges that deepen mutual understanding between the UK and Japan. UK office holds three annual awards meetings; Japan office holds two.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Awards of up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields considered. Project must involve partners in both UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applicants welcomed. Apply to the UK office.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, broad in application and supporting study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
